query: DO $$ DECLARE v_buyer_id INT; v_product_id INT; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_buyer_id FROM users WHERE email = 'rainbowflix000@gmail.com' LIMIT 1; SELECT id INTO v_product_id FROM digital_products WHERE name ILIKE '%Spider%' LIMIT 1; IF v_product_id IS NULL THEN SELECT id INTO v_product_id FROM products WHERE title ILIKE '%Spider%' LIMIT 1; END IF; INSERT INTO orders ("buyerId", "sellerId", "digitalProductId", "productType", "productName", "quantity", "totalPrice", "status", "buyerPhone", "createdAt") VALUES (COALESCE(v_buyer_id, 1), NULL, v_product_id, 'digital', 'Spider-Man Remastered PS5', 1, '98.90', 'pago', '555591776810', NOW()); END $$;
